stage0081_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「So, it's underground in this city.」

stage0081_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「That's what Lord $$ハーデス$$ said.」

stage0081_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Then let us burn the city above,
　and search for the way below.」

stage0081_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$不動$$
「That's far enough.
　They'll be your opponents now.」

stage0081_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「You feeble humans.
　Still haven't learned to stop
　fighting us?」

stage0081_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$不動$$
「Save words like that for after
　you've beaten them.」

stage0081_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Supreme Commander $$不動$$!?
　When did you...!」

stage0081_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$不動$$
「War prizes swiftness over skill.
　All the more so for a commander.」

stage0081_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「So he added the $$オリジナル$$
　to Sun Tzu's Art of War?」

stage0081_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Come to think of it, that $$あしゅら$$
　bastard hit this city too...!」

stage0081_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$シモン$$
「So the Mycenaeans inherited that, huh!」

stage0081_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$ミサト$$
（Their target really is NERV
　Headquarters, after all...）

stage0081_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$桂$$
「Let's go, $$アマタ$$...!
　Don't let your guard down!」

stage0081_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Why are you teaming up with us, $$桂$$?」

stage0081_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$桂$$
（It's the bond from being her judge.
　I'll see this through, $$ゼシカ$$.）

stage0081_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Even though the battle hasn't
　started yet!?」

stage0081_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$不動$$
「Element Change!
　Swapping $$カイエン・スズシロ$$
　for $$ミコノ・スズシロ$$!」

stage0081_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$不動$$
「Also, no further Element Changes
　are allowed in this battle.」

stage0081_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「$$ミコノ$$, $$アマタ$$, and I have to fight...」

stage0081_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Complaining to him won't help anyway!
　Let's go, $$ミコノ$$, $$ゼシカ$$!」

stage0081_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$モーム$$
「Master $$桂$$!
　Something's wrong with $$ゼシカ$$!」

stage0081_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$桂$$
（Mr. $$不動$$... did you see this
　coming and do that Element Change
　on purpose...）

stage0081_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$桂$$
（I can't read what that man's thinking.
　Feels like I've met someone similar
　somewhere before, though...）

stage0081_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$桂$$
（Something still feels hazy around
　Aquarion... Are there memories
　still unresolved...）

stage0081_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, intercept the Mycenaeans.
　Remember, this city is inhabited,
　and NERV Headquarters lies below.」

stage0081_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$アスカ$$
（My fingertip hurts...
　Guess I cut it prepping squid earlier.）

stage0081_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$シンジ$$
「You okay, $$アスカ$$?
　You seem kind of tired.」

stage0081_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Whose fault do you think this is!」

stage0081_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$アスカ$$
「You'll regret this, you idiot $$シンジ$$!
　I'll show you at dinner tonight!」

stage0081_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「The skeleton we fought in space!」

stage0081_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$アンディ$$
「That $$ミカゲ$$ bastard's shown up!」

stage0081_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「I see...!
　That explains why that man
　called $$不動$$ was there!」

stage0081_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Shall I say it's been a while,
　gods of Olympus...」

stage0081_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$アマタ$$
「That guy...!
　Does he know about the Mycenaeans!?」

stage0081_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「How pitiful.
　Still fighting for revenge, even
　down to the last of you?」

stage0081_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Watch your tongue.
　You're just evolution's dead end,
　obsessed with sheer power.」

stage0081_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「You...!
　Do you mean to mock us,
　the gods of Olympus!」

stage0081_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Those two... are they enemies
　of each other?」

stage0081_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$シュレード$$
「A tremendous dissonance...
　One that shakes even dimensions...」

stage0081_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$不動$$
（That, that is the real war...）

stage0081_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$オズマ$$
「Looks like Altair and the Mycenaeans
　are set on wiping each other out...!」

stage0081_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Here's our chance, $$アマタ$$!
　Catch that $$ミカゲ$$ guy and
　get $$ＭＩＸ$$ back!」

stage0081_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Can you manage it, Mechanical Angels?
　Not as you are now.」

stage0081_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$n
（That guy...!
　Does he know about $$ゼシカ$$'s
　condition!）

stage0081_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Heh heh... a hit, and a miss...
　It's sad for the one not chosen.」

stage0081_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$桂$$
「I see. I'm starting to figure out
　just what you are.」

stage0081_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The root of it all, a singularity,
　is it...」

stage0081_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$桂$$
「You seem so cool and collected,
　but deep down you're piling up a
　ton of stress... and that much means...」

stage0081_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$桂$$
「Here's my guess!
　Someone dumped you once, and
　you've held a grudge ever since!」

stage0081_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$桂$$
「A personality that petty and clingy
　almost always comes from some
　romantic trauma. Just my experience.」

stage0081_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$桂$$
「Guys like that hate anything positive,
　love, hope, dreams, you name it,
　so they spread hatred at the world!」

stage0081_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$桂$$
「Your composed mask's coming off, $$ミカゲ$$!」

stage0081_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「How laughable!
　Still chasing after him, are you!」

stage0081_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「Is that why you came to this world!」

stage0081_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「...Olympus... and the wingless...!
　Don't think you'll die an easy
　death...!」

stage0081_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$赤木$$
「Running off with your tail
　between your legs!」

stage0081_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$シモン$$
「Did that hit a little too close
　to home...?」

stage0081_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Well done, $$桂$$.
　This was your silver tongue's
　victory this time.」

stage0081_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$桂$$
「Figured if I made him mad enough
　to lose his cool, a bluff would
　land. Bingo, looks like.」

stage0081_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$n
「That thing you said earlier...
　wasn't it based on something!」

stage0081_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$桂$$
「Wasn't a total shot in the dark, though.」

stage0081_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$桂$$
「That's the gist of it, $$ゼシカ$$.
　Don't worry about what he said.」

stage0081_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$桂$$
「Hits, misses...
　Nobody who talks about people's lives
　like some rigged fate is any good.」

stage0081_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$桂$$
「That's something you decide yourself.
　It's not set in stone beforehand.」

stage0081_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
（$$アマタ$$ hasn't given up...
　Even if $$ミコノ$$'s fated match
　is that beast...）

stage0081_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$桂$$
「Alright, let's go, kids!
　The self-proclaimed gods and
　the skeleton are waiting!」

stage0081_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「$$バサラ$$!
　Give that skeleton a good, long
　dose of your hot-blooded singing!」

stage0081_04:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Yeah! I'll get even the museum's
　dinosaurs dancing too!!」

stage0081_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$隼人$$
「They're wiping each other out...!
　Let's use that to our advantage!」

stage0081_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Don't give me that lame talk!
　I'll crush the Mycenaeans and
　that skeleton together!」

stage0081_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
（I'm going to fight too!
　Even if I'm the miss...!）

stage0081_04:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$不動$$
「A ladies' man who's crossed
　time and space, as expected...」

stage0081_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$不動$$
「Seems there's no role for me today.」

stage0081_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$渓$$
「Well, we managed to clean that up.」

stage0081_04:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$凱$$
「Both that skeleton and the
　Mycenaeans are tough opponents.」

stage0081_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$弁慶$$
「But they see each other as enemies.
　There's an opening to exploit there.」

stage0081_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$桂$$
「Well, it'll turn out however
　it turns out. Overthink the future
　and you'll wear yourself out.」

stage0081_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$桂$$
「The Managing Director might've said
　that, but I thought $$ゼシカ$$'s onion
　rings were tasty.」

stage0081_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$厚井$$
（I didn't say it was bad either...）

stage0081_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$柿小路$$
（Now, now, Managing Director...
　let's leave this to $$桂$$.）

stage0081_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$桂$$
（Even without being fated to someone,
　you can still be loved by someone...
　Well... shouldn't say that now...）

stage0081_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$桂$$
（Hang in there, $$ゼシカ$$.
　$$ミコノ$$, $$アスカ$$, $$レイ#333$$, too...）

stage0081_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$桂$$
（I'm rooting for all of you equally.）

stage0081_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$ミカ$$
「Altair's been shot down by
　the Mycenaeans.」

stage0081_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$ナオト$$
「It'd help if Altair and the
　Mycenaeans just wiped each other
　out like this.」

stage0081_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$アキラ$$
「And then we take out whoever's left, huh?」

stage0081_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$ケンジ$$
「Things won't always go that conveniently.
　We'll fight this with our own strength.」

stage0081_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$ミカ$$
「The Mycenaeans have been shot
　down by Altair.」

stage0081_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$ナオト$$
「It'd help if Altair and the
　Mycenaeans just wiped each other
　out like this.」

stage0081_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$アキラ$$
「And then we take out whoever's left, huh?」

stage0081_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$ケンジ$$
「Things won't always go that conveniently.
　We'll fight this with our own strength.」

stage0081_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$シンジ$$
（Once this fight's over, $$アスカ$$'s
　dinner will be waiting...
　I've gotta do my best.）

stage0081_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$シンジ$$
（In case something comes out I
　can't eat, I should think up a
　quick backup menu...）

stage0081_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$アスカ$$
「No time to struggle with these guys!
　There's a big showdown waiting
　after this!」

stage0081_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$アスカ$$
（Watch closely, Teacher's Pet...!
　This time I'll settle things for good!）

stage0081_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$レイ#333$$
（Something to fill the emptiness...
　For me, that would be...）

stage0081_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$アマタ$$
（Even if $$ミコノ$$'s fated match is
　that beast from Altair,
　I won't give up...!）

stage0081_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$アマタ$$
（I won't... ever give up again!
　I don't want to lose someone
　precious!!）

stage0081_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$ミコノ$$
（Everyone's trying so hard...!
　To change fate... to change
　the future!）

stage0081_04:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$ミコノ$$
（I'll do it too...!
　Together with everyone, and $$アマタ$$!）

stage0081_04:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
（A hit, and a miss...
　I might be the miss, for $$アマタ$$...!）

stage0081_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
（But I'll still fight...!
　To change my own fate myself!）

stage0081_04:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$桂$$
「What are you talking about, $$モーム$$.
　Aren't I always a wonderful $$桂$$?」

stage0081_04:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$桂$$
「And why don't I show these kids
　that wonderful $$桂$$'s an ace
　pilot too!」

stage0081_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$桂$$
「Alright, let's go!
　Handsome, unbeatable me can't
　lose to gods or skeletons!」

stage0081_04:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$甲児$$
「Watch closely, Mycenae!
　I'll show you the human strength you call powerless!」

stage0081_04:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$甲児$$
「As long as we're here,
　don't think you can have things your way!!」
